title: narcissus gigas
intro: Narcissus gigas, commonly known as the giant daffodil, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Amaryllidaceae family. It is valued for its vibrant yellow flowers and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including galantamine, which has been shown to have neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory properties, and is also used to treat memory-related issues such as Alzheimer's disease. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus gigas include its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, improve mood, and promote relaxation, making it a popular natural remedy in aromatherapy and herbal medicine.
